integrity: The theorem is supported by a complete analytical block proof, an explicit global optimization and factorial remainder estimate. Finite script assertions are supplementary and are not a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Centered disks and the full order-two Gaussian polyanalytic Fock space only. The result does not extend here to higher orders or nonradial sets; independent mathematical priority verification is outstanding.
title: A sharp noncommutativity constant for nested-disk concentration in the bianalytic Fock space
